text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! What even? Ahaha! This is so not
fair!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, Trainer! My mom sent me a
picture
of my little sisters and... Ahaha!
Their faces are so
silly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When I have a race coming up, she tries
to make
me laugh by sending pictures
like this. Well, she
sure got me this time!
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I think she's saying, "Get out there with
that smile
of yours and have fun!" Hehe,
can't let her down
now, can I? ♪
